name: PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk
summary: PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the oil palm plantation business in Indonesia. It offers crude palm oil, palm kernel, and palm kernel oil, as well as fresh fruit bunches. The company is also involved in harvesting and processing dry sago starch under the PATI ALAM and SAPAPUA brands; and cultivating edamame, as well as frozen edamame under the Edashi brand. It generates electricity through methane gas plants. The company was formerly known as PT Austindo Teguh Jaya and changed its name to PT Austindo Nusantara Jaya Tbk in July 1998.
